progress.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE independent transparent game progress-track sprite as a separate engine asset, using the attached approved chest screen only as style reference. A slim horizontal capsule about 8:1 width to height, dark forest-green recessed empty interior, thin sage/lime-green rounded bevel rim with restrained top highlight and dark green lower edge, exactly the visual family of the progress bar under the chest in the LEFT reference panel. The outer border must be GREEN, NOT gold, tan, cream or metallic. Capsule ends fully semicircular. Top-down orthographic front view, perfectly horizontal, narrow regular rail, no perspective, no center highlights resembling text. EMPTY unfilled track. No star, no counter, no letters, no numbers, no icons, no background scene, no shadow outside a tiny integrated lower bevel. Transparent RGBA outside the capsule, clean edges, ample transparent safety margin. This is a missing standalone asset, not a screen redesign. Keep the green rim slender, not an elaborate picture frame.
